[2026 in Canada]
Nine people are killed in a shooting in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia.

[Tumbler Ridge Secondary School]
On February 10, 2026, a former student opened fire at the school with a modified handgun and a long gun after killing her mother and step-brother at their home in Tumbler Ridge.
